Yogendra Yadav Criticizes Government Over Sonam Wangchuk's Protest

Yogendra Yadav has expressed strong criticism regarding the government's response to activist Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike. Yadav described Wangchuk's removal from the protest site as one of India's most shameful acts and voiced anger over the government's silence on the matter. The situation highlights tensions surrounding environmental activism and government engagement with protesters.
